info.name: Addresses Introduction Account Addresses OIDC Authentication API

params.name: realmId
params.description: The ID of the authentication realm.

params.name: client_id
params.description: The Client ID, for Account Management Authentication see the `meta.client_id` field on [Account Authentication Settings](/docs/api/accounts/get-v-2-settings-account-authentication).

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: Redirection URI to which the response will be sent. Must exactly match a pre-registered redirect URI for the client in the `redirect_uris` of the [Authentication Realm](/docs/api/single-sign-on/get-v-2-authentication-realms-realm-id).

params.name: response_type
params.description: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 response type, this must be "code" in Commerce.

params.name: scope
params.description: Space-delimited list of scopes. Must include "openid", "email", and "name".

params.name: state
params.description: Opaque value used to maintain state between the request and the callback. Helps prevent CSRF.

params.name: code_challenge_method
params.description: [Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE)](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7636) transformation method that was used to derive code_challenge.

params.name: code_challenge
params.description: [Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE)](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7636) Code Challenge.

params.name: prompt
params.description: Space-delimited, case-sensitive list that specifies whether the Authorization Server prompts the End-User for re-authentication and consent.  This value is passed to the configured IdP. See [Section 3.1.2.1. Authentication Request - OpenID Connect Core 1.0](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html#AuthRequest).

params.name: display
params.description: ASCII string value that specifies how the Authorization Server displays the authentication and consent user interface. This value is passed to the configured IdP. See [Section 3.1.2.1. Authentication Request - OpenID Connect Core 1.0](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html#AuthRequest).

params.name: ui_locales
params.description: End-User's preferred languages and scripts for the user interface, represented as space-separated list of BCP47 language tag values. This value is forwarded to the configured IdP.  See [Section 3.1.2.1. Authentication Request - OpenID Connect Core 1.0](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html#AuthRequest).

params.name: elasticpath_commerce_cloud_profile_id
params.description: Selects the specific OIDC Profile within the realm to use for authentication.

params.name: ep_report_callback_replay_error
params.description: Custom boolean flag. If true, if the user attempts to hit back in their browser, we will redirect them back to the store front

items.docs:
Initiate the OIDC login flow for a specific store and authentication realm
::: note This is not an **API Endpoint**, but the [Authentication Request](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-core-1_0.html#AuthRequest) of the OpenID Connect Authentication Flow.
To initiate an OpenID Connect authentication you must change the location in the Browser to this URL, not call it asynchronously. :::

params.name: realmId
params.description: The ID of the authentication realm.

params.name: elasticpath_commerce_cloud_profile_id
params.description: The ID of the [OIDC profile](/docs/api/single-sign-on/oidc-profiles) that you would like to authenticate with

items.docs:
Returns the OpenID Connect discovery document for the authentication realm.
This endpoint provides metadata about the OIDC provider's configuration, including endpoints, supported features, and capabilities. Some libraries might require an OIDC discovery document in order to work.
For more information see [OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0](https://openid.net/specs/openid-connect-discovery-1_0.html)
